name: Garlic-Avocado Toast with Marinated Mozzarella, Basil & Side Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince the sun-dried tomatoes and place in a small bowl. Add oil and spices; stir to combine the marinade.
Cut mozzarella into ½-inch cubes and add to the bowl with the marinade; gently toss to coat the cheese and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and mince bell pepper; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Mince artichokes and add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in another small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
Slice buns in half and place, cut-side up, on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with garlic oil.
Place buns in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Set aside.
Halve and pit the avocados; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Arrange avocado slices on top of the garlic toast.
To serve, divide garlic-avocado toast and salad between plates; spoon marinated mozzarella over the toasts and garnish with basil. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
